original_role: INPUT validation: verify focus/lighting/framing before trusting AI
heatmap: MODEL VIEW: fixed cross-image support evidence; auto-OK is color-capped to avoid false alarm red; never per-image min-max
overlay: FINAL UI: OK=no red; REVIEW/NG=red model-evidence region; no label-dependent painting
contour: FINAL UI: red contour marks model evidence for a non-OK decision; actual GOOD/BAD label never affects inference
